vocabulary.meaning_en: the act of politely asking for something
vocabulary.example: She made a polite request for help.

vocabulary.meaning_en: speaking or acting in a kind, respectful way
vocabulary.example: Please be polite to our clients.
It sounds rude to give orders to colleagues.

vocabulary.meaning_en: always telling other people what to do
vocabulary.example: Don't be bossy with your colleagues.
I didn't want to upset Denise.

vocabulary.meaning_en: make a paper copy of a computer document
vocabulary.example: Could you print out this file for me?

vocabulary.meaning_en: prepare a machine or system so it is ready to use
vocabulary.example: Can you help me set up the printer?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a document on a computer or in a folder
vocabulary.example: The file should be on the system.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a piece of written or printed information
a company that sells goods to another company
vocabulary.example: They are one of our suppliers.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the computer network a company uses
vocabulary.example: All files are saved on the system.

vocabulary.meaning_en: before the end of a period of time
vocabulary.example: Could I have it within ten minutes, please?

vocabulary.meaning_en: information about the history of a situation or company
vocabulary.example: Please read the background file on this client.

vocabulary.meaning_en: used in requests to make them more polite
because you asked in a kind, polite way
vocabulary.example: OK, since you asked so nicely, I'll help.

fine_lines.title: could vs would in requests
fine_lines.explanation_ar: كلاهما يجعل الطلب مهذبًا. Could you...? تسأل عن القدرة، Would you...? تسأل عن الرغبة. وبعد Would you mind نستخدم -ing.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both make requests polite. "Could you...?" asks about ability; "Would you...?" asks about willingness. After "Would you mind" use -ing.

examples.sentence: Could you send me the file?
Would you mind sending me the file?

fine_lines.title: please alone vs could you please
fine_lines.explanation_ar: كلمة please وحدها مع فعل أمر قد تبدو كأمر وتبدو غير مهذبة بين الزملاء. الأفضل: Could you possibly... أو Would you mind...
fine_lines.explanation_en: Using only "please" with an order can sound rude. It is better to use "Could you possibly...?" or "Would you mind...?"

examples.sentence: Please email me the file. (can sound bossy)
Could you possibly email me the file? (polite)

expressions.phrase: I was wondering if you could do something for me.
expressions.meaning_ar: كنت أتساءل إن كان بإمكانك أن تفعل شيئًا لي.
expressions.meaning_en: A very polite way to start a request.
expressions.example: I was wondering if you could check this report for me.

expressions.phrase: Would you be able to print out a file for me?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل بإمكانك أن تطبع لي ملفًا؟
expressions.meaning_en: Politely ask if someone can do a task.
expressions.example: Would you be able to print out the agenda for me?

expressions.phrase: Could I have it within ten minutes, please?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنني الحصول عليه خلال عشر دقائق من فضلك؟
expressions.example: Could I have the report within an hour, please?

expressions.phrase: Could you possibly help me with the printer?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنك من فضلك أن تساعدني في الطابعة؟
expressions.meaning_en: A polite request for help; "possibly" makes it softer.
expressions.example: Could you possibly help me with this form?

expressions.phrase: Would you mind writing your email later?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل تمانع أن تكتب بريدك الإلكتروني لاحقًا؟
expressions.meaning_en: Politely ask someone to change what they are doing.
expressions.example: Would you mind closing the window?

grammar.title: Polite request patterns
grammar.explanation_ar:
للطلب المهذب نستخدم could وwould بدل الأمر المباشر:
- Could you (possibly) + فعل مجرد?
- Would you be able to + فعل مجرد?
- Would you mind + فعل بـ -ing?
- I was wondering if you could + فعل مجرد.
كلما كانت الجملة أطول كانت أكثر تهذيبًا.
grammar.explanation_en:
Use could and would instead of a direct order:
- Could you (possibly) + base verb?
- Would you be able to + base verb?
- Would you mind + -ing?
- I was wondering if you could + base verb.
Longer forms sound more polite.
examples: Could you possibly send me the file?
Would you be able to call the supplier?
Would you mind waiting a moment?
I was wondering if you could help me.

grammar.title: Answering "Would you mind...?"
grammar.explanation_ar: Would you mind...? تعني: هل تمانع؟ لذا للموافقة نقول No, not at all أو Of course not (أي لا أمانع)، لا نقول Yes.
grammar.explanation_en: "Would you mind...?" asks if you object. To agree, say "No, not at all" or "Of course not" (= I don't mind).
examples: A: Would you mind closing the door? B: No, not at all.
A: Would you mind waiting? B: Of course not.
A: Would you mind helping me? B: Not at all. What do you need?

questions.question: Would you mind ___ me the file?
Which request is the most polite?
choices: Please send me the file now.
Could you possibly send me the file?
questions.explanation_ar: Could you possibly... هي الأكثر تهذيبًا.
questions.explanation_en: "Could you possibly..." is the most polite.

questions.question: I was wondering if you ___ help me.
questions.explanation_ar: العبارة الصحيحة: I was wondering if you could.
questions.explanation_en: The phrase is "I was wondering if you could".

questions.question: "Would you mind waiting?" To agree politely, you answer:
questions.explanation_ar: للموافقة على Would you mind نقول No, not at all.
questions.explanation_en: Say "No, not at all" to agree.

questions.question: Why was Denise upset?
questions.explanation_ar: انزعجت دينيس لأن طلب آنا بدا كأمر.

questions.question: "Within ten minutes" means...
questions.explanation_ar: within تعني خلال أو في غضون.
questions.explanation_en: Within means in that time or less.

questions.question: A supplier is a company that...
questions.explanation_ar: supplier هو المورّد الذي يبيع لنا.
questions.explanation_en: A supplier sells goods to another company.

questions.question: Would you be able ___ the report?
questions.explanation_ar: بعد be able نستخدم to + فعل.

questions.question: Choose the sentence that sounds bossy.
choices: I was wondering if you could help.
questions.explanation_ar: الأمر المباشر مع please قد يبدو متسلطًا.
questions.explanation_en: A direct order with only "please" can sound bossy.

questions.question: "Print out" means...
questions.explanation_en: It means make a paper copy.
